name: crossflow-cube-tuned
description: The crossflow cube tuned with the whole-exchanger simulation (porous.py): a 1.5 mm seal band instead of 2 mm, and ports sized per fluid (water 10 mm, air 18 mm). Simulated against the original: water pressure drop 745 -> 267 Pa, air 8.5 -> 1.9 kPa, effectiveness 0.348 -> 0.377, 5% more plastic.
